items.title: A keyword-starved focus asks Cohere before giving up the day (your approved 11-25 note, built as a draft)
items.detail: Built as you approved: when the week's focus is still short of four matches after its own bonus stories, one Cohere rerank scores the on-charter pool against the focus, and four stories at or over the cutoff keep the focus and centre the deep dive (Wednesday's home NAS, offline garage-door opener and solar-panel guide would qualify). It is a draft for two things the proposal did not say: it adds one Cohere rerank ($0.002) on a keyword-starved day where the focus is not found, about $0.03 a month, and its 0.3 cutoff is a first guess with every score logged for a refit.
items.fix: Approve to merge it as it stands; decline to close it; or say in a comment what cutoff or limit you want.

items.title: The review job stops waiting 15 minutes for nothing (another session's PR)
items.detail: From another session today. The review job's wait for the review to go live used grep -q under pipefail, which always reads as a failure, so every run waited all 30 tries (15 minutes) before refreshing super-rss-feed's editorial items. A one-line change to the workflow; nothing on air changes. CI green, merges cleanly.
items.fix: Approve to merge it; decline to close it.

items.title: Category keywords match whole words, not substrings (another session's PR)
items.detail: From another session today. The category rules, the prescore gate and feed discovery matched keywords inside other words (cern in concern, aging in managing, llm in hallmark). Measured on 2,475 articles, 63 that were admitted by coincidence stop passing the gate and 92 change category; nine stems gain a * so real inflections still match. It changes what the feed admits, so it needs your call. CI green, merges cleanly.
items.fix: Approve to merge it; decline to close it.
